issuing_body: The White House (President of the United States)
covered_actors: Assistant to the President for Science and Technology (APST)
Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP)
enforcement_authorities: Assistant to the President for Science and Technology (APST)
Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP)
compliance_deadlines: Within 60 days of September 29, 2026 (by November 28, 2026): APST, in consultation with agency heads as appropriate, shall submit proposed legislative language to establish a Federal definition of 'Super Intelligence' and 'SI', conforming statutory amendments, and recommendations for additional executive action.
implementation_notes: Signed September 29, 2026 (filed in the Federal Register on October 1, 2026, and published at 91 FR 63129 on October 2, 2026). Directs executive departments and agencies, to the maximum extent permitted by law, to use 'Super Intelligence' and 'SI' instead of 'Artificial Intelligence' and 'AI' in official correspondence, public communications, websites, reports, policy documents, and other non-statutory documents, and not to acknowledge the usage of 'Artificial Intelligence' and 'AI' in applicable settings. Does not require altering previously issued regulations, Presidential actions, contracts, grants, or other historical documents. Adopts the existing statutory definition of 'artificial intelligence' in 15 U.S.C. 9401(3) on an interim basis unless superseded by subsequent Presidential action or Act of Congress. Subject to applicable law and availability of appropriations, and creates no legally enforceable rights or benefits.
